metadata_reference./Title: Expected yield at equal weighted contact capacity
metadata_reference./Subject: Screening rules share the same expected weighted coverage. At 50% coverage, the five-state and digital rules yield 24.59 and 24.19 cases per 100 expected weighted contacts. The lower panel compares the five-state rule with digital, integrated and retrospectively selected best binary rules. Line patterns and markers distinguish those comparisons.

metadata_reference./Title: Composition of expected weighted contacts at half coverage
metadata_reference./Subject: Four stacked bars show the share of expected weighted contacts by original technology state at 50% expected weighted coverage. Both the full and digital rules allocate 68.13% to manual planners. Digital coding shifts 7.39 percentage points from standard software to three more advanced states. Patterns distinguish the five states. A table below the bars gives each share as a percentage.
